## Standard & Quality Checklist

- [ ] 100% Client-side processing with zero external API calls or telemetry
- [ ] Conforms to 3-30-300 standard (max 3 params, <=30 executable lines/function, <=300 lines/file)
- [ ] Unit tests added with all edge cases covered
- [ ] Responsive across Mobile (<640px), Tablet (640-1023px), and Desktop (>=1024px)
- [ ] Both Light and Dark themes tested with high contrast
- [ ] Accessible keyboard navigation and WCAG 2.2 AA compliant focus indicators
- [ ] `pnpm lint`, `pnpm test`, and `pnpm build` pass locally
